body.summary: Switched createChatPanelHost to turn-lifecycle.ts: runTurn keeps the echo, title and request and hands the turn to turns.start with a TurnSink; followLiveTurn uses turns.follow; cancel-turn, chat switches, dispose and adopt use stop/detach/invalidate; decide uses turns.live. The moved turn state and functions left the closure (chat-panel.ts 1220 -> 948 lines). No test file or extension.ts changed.
